newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted at mixed levels on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted at mixed levels on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mixed levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus no barges traded on Monday.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, Clinton and South, Load and Release by December 3, $250 per day thereafter, no bid, offered 195 percent, down five percentage points.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 160 percent of tariff, up 2-1/2 percentage points, offer, one barge at 170 percent.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Illinois River, bid 155 percent, unchanged from Monday, offer 165 percent, unchanged.
- 10 barges, two each week December, Lower Ohio River, bid 125 percent, unchanged from Monday, offer one barge each week at 135 percent, down five percentage points.
